caption: The drawing depicts a wooden clock case with a rich brown hue, featuring elaborately carved decorative elements at the top and at the feet. The upper section of the case has a glass door, through which a clock face is visible; the face is predominantly white with black Roman numerals and two smaller inset dials. Green floral motifs are painted in the corners surrounding the clock face. Below the clock face, separated by a horizontal wooden divider, there is a rectangular panel with a painted scene showing a white church with a tall steeple, surrounded by a white fence, trees, and grass in green and earthy tones. The overall composition is centered on a plain light background, and the clock’s details, including wood grain, carvings, and painted scenes, are carefully rendered.
title: Shelf Clock
